comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Item 0 is 1 if any comment argues that the OP's own premises contradict each other or the OP's conclusion (a semantic argument-content judgment). Item 1 is 1 if any comment quotes OP title or argument text verbatim or near-verbatim, with no endorsement or argument required (a quotation-presence check). The two predicates have different positive conditions, and a quote does not imply a contradiction claim, or the reverse. Their null rules also differ: item 0 gives null if title and argument are both missing, and item 1 adds a rule that a clear positive match still gives 1.
